messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — int8 Q4B canary is showing concentrated failures on anchorset after quant kernels swap. Failures clustered on policy & finance prompts. Need a small golden refresh and relabel pass.

liam: how big a batch are we thinking? can we target top delta examples only?

marta: pulling 150 highest delta/conf mismatches (float_conf>=0.9, delta_score>0.1). Command used:
```bash
python tools/sample_golden.py --dataset anchorset --filter 'delta>0.10 and conf_float>=0.9' --limit 150 --tag relabel_q4b_int8
```

labeler-bot: 150 items queued to curation:golden_relabel_queue (priority=high). ETA ~90m.

ada: Rubric? last quant incident we broadened acceptance for paraphrases.

marta: Stick with binary for speed: PASS / FAIL / AMBIGUOUS. Note: paraphrase ok if intent + required obligations match. Ambiguous -> short note.

rene: I'll assign 3 labelers (50 each). QA rule: >=95% agreement or escalate to marta.

labeler-bot: Assigned -> @tara @niko @sam (50/50/50). Progress updates posted here.

liam: after relabel please run regress: `scripts/regress.py --models float32,q4b-int8 --dataset anchorset --out /tmp/reg_int8.csv` and log to dashboard path quant/onboard/q4b-int8. threshold for rollback is delta >8% overall or >10% on priority slices.

marta: Agreed. If we hit threshold we rollback canary. Sam will coordinate.

labeler-bot: Update: 70/150 labeled; 10 ambiguous; 4 escalated.

labeler-bot: Final: 150/150 labeled. Consensus: 128 PASS, 17 FAIL, 5 AMBIGUOUS.

liam: regress output: float pass 91.7%, int8 pass 82.0% (delta 9.7%). Policy slice delta = 13.4%. finance slice delta = 9.1%.

marta: >8% overall and >10% policy slice -> rollback. Sam, please run rollback plan.

labeler-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0472.

sam: Rollback executed: `deploy rollback q4b-int8 --tag canary-2026-03-21` canary stopped. Scheduling postmortem to investigate kernel selection and tokenizer edgecases.

ada: follow-ups: add more finance/policy examples to anchorset, add quant-specific pre-canary checklist including kernel diff smoke, and add a small A/B test harness for future changes.

marta: Added to tracker. Thanks all for fast turn-around.
